judged_text: poll_feed iterates rss.items with no per-item error isolation while the job runs with sidekiq_options retry: false (line 13), so the first item lacking a content element — SimpleRSS returns nil for missing tags — raises NoMethodError on nil.scrub at line 36 and kills the run mid-loop, deterministically, on every hourly execution. Every item after the first content-less entry (common in RSS 2.0 feeds without content:encoded) is dropped forever — the importer stalls at the same item on every run with no retry, topics simply stop appearing, and the only evidence is a sidekiq failure entry; the same mechanism means any single bad item (nil title, PostCreator failure) permanently blocks all later feed items.

adjudication.rationale: In `app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb`, the loop does `content = CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)` for each RSS item. If `i.content` is `nil` (common when feeds lack a `content`/`content:encoded` element), calling `.scrub` will raise `NoMethodError`, aborting the job mid-iteration. The job is configured with `sidekiq_options retry: false`, so that run will not be retried, and subsequent scheduled executions will deterministically fail again as long as the feed continues to include such an item, preventing later items from being processed.
